async function run(items, width) {
 let size = 4;
 size = 1;
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += size) { await Promise.all(items.slice(i,i+size).map(read)); }
 for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i = i + width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  if (items.length) { await Promise.all(items.slice(i,i+width).map(read)); }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await other(i);
 }
 for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all([read(items[i])]);
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of chunk(items, width)) { await Promise.all(batch.map(read)); }
}
